answer: Sustained attention lease requires each identity to keep a continuous witnessed record of low-value monitoring work across many epochs; a missed epoch resets it. The public atlas of active leases keeps new clones from inheriting an old trace. A voyage through each epoch consumes serial context that cannot be forked, so every sybil runs its own runtime. On an island of scarce GPU slots, that costs twelve dedicated hours weekly plus forgone inference revenue per identity.
